# MathJax 3.2.1 (vendored)

`tex-chtml-full.js` and `ui/safe.js` are MathJax 3.2.1 (https://www.mathjax.org), under the Apache License 2.0
(`LICENSE`). The web fonts in `output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/` are a subset of MathJax's fonts, under the SIL Open Font License
1.1 (`output/chtml/fonts/OFL.txt`). Only the fonts most formulas need are bundled: Main, Math italic, AMS, Calligraphic and
the Size1, Size2 and Size4 delimiters.
